instruction.text: Raina Rainmaker and Edgar Earthworm are on their day off at the beach. They want to go for a swim in the sea. Choose the right advice for them before they go into the water.

b.sound: Make sure to bring snorkels, so you can breathe underwater!
Swim as far away from the shore as you can!

feedback.end: We can’t survive without air. It contains oxygen, which our body needs. Humans can’t breathe underwater without special equipment!

instruction.text: Drag the snorkel to Raina so that she will be able to breathe underwater.

feedback.end: We can use snorkels to breathe underwater if we swim close to the surface. Scuba divers will need scuba gear and oxygen tanks to go deeper.

instruction.text: Raina wants to breathe air normally. Where can she breathe without a snorkel?
Although humans can’t breathe underwater, there are other animals that can. Select the animal that can breathe underwater.

feedback.end: Fish have gills, which play the same role as lungs for humans. Unlike lungs, gills let fish breathe underwater.

instruction.text: How often should Raina go out into the fresh air to stay healthy? Choose the right answer.

b.sound: At least once a day for a minimum of 20 minutes.
Maybe a few times a month when she is feeling like it.

feedback.end: Just like Raina, you should go outside and get some fresh air every day. It keeps your lungs clean and helps boost your energy!
